About Chef Blaze

With roots in Macedonia and Italy, Chef Blaze brings passion, precision, and heritage to every plate. His culinary journey began in his grandmother’s kitchen and evolved through years of training and international experience. Specializing in intimate, high-end dining experiences, he combines Mediterranean warmth with contemporary flair. Whether you're hosting a private dinner or a special celebration, Chef Blaze creates unforgettable meals tailored to your tastes.
